maddeler.e:
نغتسل (form VIII)
# نَغْتَسِلُ (naḡtasilu) /naɣ.ta.si.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# نَغْتَسِلَ (naḡtasila) /naɣ.ta.si.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# نَغْتَسِلْ (naḡtasil) /naɣ.ta.sil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
